mcq_fix.s: Who is the present Attorney General of India?

mcq_drop.why: ambiguous A/R: R merely cites the Article, explanation link unclear
ambiguous A/R: R restates content of A's Article

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
garbled: statements merged with another question's text
suspect key: AG has MP privileges (Art. 105(4)), so neither statement is correct

patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks 'highest/first law officer of India' = Attorney General (not CJI or Law Minister).
Statement items: appointed by President, SC-judge qualification, right of audience = correct; pleasure of PM, fixed term, Parliament-set pay = wrong.
Right to participate in Parliament without vote (Art. 88) = AG, not SG/CJI/CEC - frequent one-liner.
State counterpart = Advocate General (Art. 165), legal adviser to State Government.
App mirrors these well but adds several weak A/R items and Article-pair matches beyond PYQ depth.
